execution.manifest_trust_anchor: The first argument is the exact G7 manifest digest sealed by the owner/root after the fresh holdout receipt joins the public precursor. Candidate receipts are conformant only when they bind that externally recorded digest.
execution.alternate_digest: A caller-supplied digest other than the owner-sealed G7 manifest digest is nonconformant. The verifier also rejects mechanically unless the supplied digest equals the canonical adjacent manifest bytes.
execution.verifier_identity: The canonical verifier locates adjacent manifest.json, reproduces the supplied manifest digest, requires exactly one promotion-verifier.mjs row in its public_input_closure, reproduces that row against its running bytes, and emits manifest, row, and verifier identities.
execution.pre_manifest_assays: Before manifest creation, only exported isolated helpers or a disposable external verifier/manifest copy may be tested. No governed manifest or candidate source may be created.

tool_closure.validation_order: Both complete package path/byte sets and package identities are reproduced before the ledger-bound TypeScript implementation is imported.

roots: the exact canonical candidate file whose source/overlay identity was just computed
one in-memory verifier-generated type probe; it is never persisted
source_allowlist: regular files in the complete ledger-bound TypeScript package
regular dist files in the complete ledger-bound parse-that package
isolated_compiler_program.closed_world: After resolution, every program SourceFile is canonicalized and rejected unless it is exactly in the allowlist. Workspace configs/globs, root node_modules, ambient @types, sibling cells, and all other declarations are outside the program. Every admitted source is byte-hashed, classified, emitted, and included in one byte-sorted resolved-input ledger and aggregate SHA-256.
isolated_compiler_program.diagnostics: All option, global, syntactic, semantic, and declaration diagnostics reject; zero diagnostics is emitted.
isolated_compiler_program.module_resolution: The probe's relative root resolves only to the exact candidate. @mkbabb/parse-that/core resolves only to the ledger-bound dist/core.d.ts. Relative imports within ledger-bound parse-that declarations resolve normally and are then checked by the source allowlist.

type_proof.export_surface: The AST floor and TypeScript module symbol must each observe exactly one export named numberStart, directly declared in the exact candidate source.
type_proof.root: The verifier-generated probe rejects any and unknown, then requires bidirectional exactness between typeof numberStart and Parser<boolean>.
type_proof.payload: The probe independently extracts Parser<infer Value>, rejects any and unknown in Value, and requires bidirectional exactness between Value and boolean. Thus Parser<any>, Parser<unknown>, Parser<true>, numeric/non-parser values, and missing/multiple exports reject.
type_proof.receipt: The receipt emits export names, symbol/declaration kind, checker-rendered observed type, type flags, observed type arguments, every probe assertion, probe identity/hash/bytes, resolved inputs, and zero-diagnostic count.

64-file parse-that dist and 130-file TypeScript package ledgers reproduce
isolated two-root strict compiler program admits only exact ledger-bound inputs and emits their complete byte ledger
zero compiler diagnostics and exact Parser<boolean> root/payload proof pass

mechanical_nonclaims: The AST visitor does not claim to recognize token/atom/component-value/CST naming or regex breadth.
The type proof establishes an exact public TypeScript root type, not runtime behavior or absence of assertions/casts.
Neither mechanism proves absence of aliases, indirection, recursion, prototype/inherited coercion, source derivation, scanner behavior, contrivance, O(1), KISS, or idiomatic parse-that.
All five exact-source skeptics retain every unclaimed axis; a mechanical pass is necessary and grants no semantic, architecture, idiom, or performance credit.
projection: The active base ledger is empty. The overlay and projected active grammar ledgers are the same one canonical row <source-sha256><two spaces>grammar/css/l4/value-unit/number-start.ts<LF>.
integration: Only after the 5-author, 5-skeptic, 3-adjudicator process may exact selected bytes be copied into the active prototype; all semantic, fresh holdout, type, no-throw, benchmark, modularity, and denominator gates rerun.
drift: Any change to the manifest, verifier, protocol, compiler options/probe, source allowlist, dependency/tool ledger, clean base, package/lock, candidate source, or resolved-input set starts a new identity.
